root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation of inclination or turning aside: something may depart from a proper direction, while a visitor turns toward the person visited and falsehood turns away from truth.
root_idea.development: The root develops from physical or directional inclination to deviation from truth, preparation or embellishment of speech, visiting by turning toward someone, and related extensions involving authority or strength.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form زَارَ rather than the inflected QAC lemma.
Displayed under the normalized Form VI perfect citation form تَزَاوَرَ.
Displayed under the dictionary nominal زُورٌ.

senses.definition: To visit; to go to someone or something, especially with the intention of seeing it.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is a perfect Form I verb meaning to visit or frequent a destination; the object is not restricted by gender, animacy, or social class.

senses.definition: To incline away or turn aside from something.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction تَزَاوَرُ عَنْ, the verb describes the sun inclining away from the cave; the Form VI reciprocal pattern here expresses directional deviation rather than mutual visiting.

senses.definition: Falsehood, a lie, or false speech; something deviating from truth.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the noun in expressions for false speech, a lie, or falsehood, including قول الزور and related coordinated constructions.

In the interpretation of لا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ, الزور may denote false testimony or bearing false witness; this is a conventional Quranic construction rather than a restriction on the noun in every context.

senses.definition: Idolatrous association: treating another as a lord or object of worship instead of God.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an explicitly reported interpretation of الزور in the Quranic passage لا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ; it is a Quran-attested interpretive use, not a general synonym for every instance of the noun.

senses.definition: A place or gathering associated with falsehood, vain diversion, singing, or other frivolous activity.
senses.usage_conditions: This is another reported interpretation of الزور in لا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ, referring to places or assemblies where such activity occurs; the sources record several competing specifications of the gathering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To visit death, meaning to die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression in which death is treated as the destination visited.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fasten the rope called زِوَار to a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to securing a rope between parts of a camel's harness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline, become crooked, or be distorted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form I intransitive use and its verbal noun; it may describe a person, an object, or a bodily part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To honor and hospitably receive a visitor, acknowledging the visitor's claim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is specifically used of treating a visitor well, including hospitality or slaughtering an animal for the visitor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impugn, annul, or invalidate testimony.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is testimony or a related claim; an illustrative application to a person being calumniated is subsumed here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stigmatize oneself by attributing falsehood to oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional reflexive construction involving self-imputation of falsehood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To falsify speech or embellish it with lies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use concerns deliberately making speech deceptive or deceptively attractive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove an obliquity, rectify, adjust, correct, or beautify a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source applies this broad transitive use to things generally and does not restrict it to good or bad objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make speech or a narrative sound right by preparing, correcting, arranging, or embellishing it before utterance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction emphasizes mental preparation and adjustment of speech; it is distinct from the separate use meaning falsification with lies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To correct or discipline oneself against oneself; alternatively, to accuse oneself of wrong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source records both explanations for this reflexive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Likeness or the act of likening one thing to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use of the Form II verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to have its crop become raised or full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological use describing the bird's crop.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause or incite someone to visit another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of the causative verb is the person made to visit, and the destination may be someone other than the speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to visit death, meaning to kill him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative causative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To introduce someone or mention his name in a eulogy or poem, thereby praising him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is introduced into praise, a eulogy, or an ode in a figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To say what is false or speak falsely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V intransitive use; it is not the same citation form as the Form II transitive uses of falsifying or preparing speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To visit one another; to engage in mutual visiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI reciprocal use, distinct from the Quranic directional use of تَزَاوَرَ عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swallow a morsel or mouthful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant use explicitly compared with اِزْدَرَدَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to visit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X causative/request construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crookedness, curving, or distortion of the breast or chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily or anatomical specialization of the general notion of inclination or distortion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose hump inclines to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an animal's form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strong, thick she-camel, especially one characterized by a sharp or vehement sideways glance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source gives both the physical description and the sharp-tempered manner of looking as applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert that is extensive, difficult, or not easy to traverse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive use of the feminine form for difficult terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction of a person toward whom one proceeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use associated with the destination or direction of a visit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The breast or chest, including its upper, middle, or otherwise specified central portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources give several anatomical specifications and also extend the term to the camel's whole breast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, or abide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom, literally depicting the breast being cast upon the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lord, chief, or person in charge of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The leadership sense is explained through people turning to that person rather than to anyone else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Determination or strength of determination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm branch, especially a straight slender branch stripped of its leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional or dialectal botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mass or piece of stone encountered while digging a well and left exposed because it cannot be broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term of well-digging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing regarded with suspicion or treated as a ground for suspicion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source equates this use with تُهَمَةٌ; it is distinct from the general meaning falsehood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object or idol worshipped instead of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended nominal use, including a particular idol in one reported specification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Judgment, understanding, intellect, or intelligence to which one can have recourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources report several closely related formulations, including strength of judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strength or firmness, including the strength of a rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source notes disagreement about whether this branch is native Arabic or an Arabicized term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deliciousness, sweetness, or pleasantness of food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sensory use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Softness and cleanness of a garment or piece of cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use of fabric.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclination, crookedness, wryness, or distortion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun describes deviation in a thing or part; specific anatomical cases are treated separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who frequently visits or associates with women, especially to converse or mix with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source primarily applies the term to a man but records rare application to a woman as well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Custom, habit, or established practice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slender, firmly twisted cord or bowstring; also the smallest string of a lute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source records both the general cord and musical-instrument applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flax, or a portion of flax.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical or material noun, with a feminine derivative for a portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vehement or rapid pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive use of the intensive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement, strong, hardy, or robust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source leaves the object open generally and applies the term especially to a strong or hardy camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel prepared for journeys or inclined to one side through briskness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The inclination in this expression need not imply distortion of the chest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The crop of a bird; also the receptacle in which a qata bird carries water to its young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thicket, wood, forest, or reed bed serving as a lion's haunt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place is named for the lion's frequenting it; the source also specifies a thicket containing grass, reeds, and water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collected or large group of camels, sheep, goats, or people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source gives a more specific range of roughly fifty to sixty for some mixed groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single visit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A count noun derived from the visiting sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distance or remoteness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension associated with turning or traveling away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that looks from the outer angle of her eye because of vehemence or sharpness of temper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized animal description in a reported poetic interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner or style of visiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing someone as good in the manner of visiting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope placed between a camel's fore-girth and kind-girth to keep the latter from injuring the animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized piece of camel equipment; a related extension denotes a means of rectification or protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means of rectifying, defending, or protecting one thing from another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the protective camel rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who visits frequently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive visitor noun, attested in a poetic example.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who visits; a visitor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source also records plural and quasi-plural uses and a related original verbal-noun interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A phantom or apparition seen in sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the visitor notion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclining, crooked, wry, or distorted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applying to a person, animal, object, or bodily part; the specific applications are separately recorded below.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dog with a narrow chest and a projecting breastbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of a dog.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or animal with a wry neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical specialization of the adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beast that looks from the outer angle of its eyes or moves with an inclination toward one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source distinguishes brisk sideways movement from actual distortion of the chest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A curved or bent bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the bow's curvature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A minaret or tower deviating from the perpendicular.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative architectural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deep well or a well dug crookedly rather than straight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A far-extending tract or desert that turns aside; by extension, a country or army so described.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative geographical or collective use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bad, crooked, or distorted saying or phrase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of physical crookedness to speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drinking cup or bowl, including an oblong drinking vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized epithet in a reported figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remote from or averse to a state of baseness or humiliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of visiting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place or time derived from the visiting verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Visited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel distorted in the breast or chest during birth or extraction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive participle describing a lasting effect of pressure or squeezing on the newborn camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speech that has been falsified or embellished with lies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial use applied to speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speech that has been corrected, arranged, prepared, or beautified before being uttered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate reported interpretation of the passive participle, emphasizing preparation rather than falsification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Visitors to the Prophet's tomb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective or plural use.

cautions: The interpretation of لا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ includes materially different reported readings: false witness, avoidance of falsehood or its gatherings, idolatrous association, and assemblies of vain diversion. These are presented as usage-specific interpretations rather than as interchangeable universal definitions.

Lane's printed Quran references use historical citation notation, including references such as Kur xviii.16 and xxii.31; no such notation has been converted directly into a modern verse location. The displayed Quran locations come from QAC, with the Form VI identification also supported independently by the supplied Mufradat discussion.
The QAC Form I group is displayed under the normalized citation form زَارَ, although its supplied Quran lemma is an inflected internal morphology identity.
